sources.title: Nemotron 3 Nano 30b | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B is NVIDIA's 30B-class LLM trained from scratch as a unified model for both reasoning and standard chat tasks. It can be configured to produce a reasoning trace before the final answer, letting developers switch reasoning behavior through the chat template.
